start.name: Beni Suef (tie-in on existing Dahshur/Beni Suef 36in gas line, agricultural land near Ezbet Abdel Hafiz, Beni Suef Governorate)
start.coord_basis: Beni Suef city-center coordinate (Wikipedia infobox, 29°04'N 31°05'E) used as the nearest named/geocodable anchor. The gazetted route description places the actual tie-in (KM 0, blow-off room 1) several km west of the city in agricultural land near 'Ezbet Abdel Hafiz' -- that hamlet is not independently geocodable via OSM/Wikipedia, so the city center is a looser proxy; treat this endpoint's position as approximate.

end.name: New Fayoum City (New Faiyum)
end.coord_basis: New Faiyum, Wikipedia infobox coordinate (29°13'26"N 30°53'48"E) -- a real, established new urban community in Faiyum Governorate.

sheet_conflicts: Sheet has StartLocation='New Fayoum City' and EndLocation blank. Egyptian Ministry of Petroleum Decree 1884/2025 (gazetted 25 Dec 2025, Official Gazette issue 291-bis(b); reproduced verbatim by elwatannews and vetogate, corroborated by almasdar) describes this as the 'Beni Suef - New Fayoum' line: it STARTS at KM 0 on the existing Dahshur/Beni Suef 36in trunk line in Beni Suef Governorate and ENDS inside New Fayoum City at KM 19.000 (blow-off room 3). So the sheet has the correct place but on the wrong end -- New Fayoum City is the END, not the start, and the true start (Beni Suef) is missing from the sheet entirely.
notes: Two independent Arabic-press reproductions (elwatannews, vetogate) of the same government decree text, plus a third (almasdar) that summarizes the decree's diameters/length/timeline -- all describe the identical cadastral route (36in tie-in at Beni Suef -> west along the Giza Canal/Beni Suef-Fayoum road -> ends in New Fayoum City), so this is well corroborated as an official, under-construction line, part of the 'Decent Life' (Hayah Karima) presidential initiative. Sheet length 18.5km vs. gazetted ~19km is a trivial rounding difference, not a conflict. Start-point coordinate is the weak link: the precise KM-0 tie-in site (near 'Ezbet Abdel Hafiz') has no independent public geocode, so Beni Suef city center is used as a loose stand-in -- flagged for a human GIS pass if precision matters.

start.name: Tie-in on the Beni Suef/New Fayoum 24in line near Demu (دمو), Faiyum Governorate desert land, ~KM 9.1
start.coord_basis: OSM/Nominatim-geocoded neighbourhood 'Masakin Demu' (مساكن دمو), the built-up area adjacent to Demu village -- the nearest named, publicly geocodable place to the gazetted tie-in point (blow-off room 2, at the end of the desert section of the Beni Suef/New Fayoum line).

end.name: Fayoum city (Madinat al-Fayoum / 'Old Fayoum'), near the Fayoum Ring Road / Fayoum Gas Company pressure-reduction station
end.coord_basis: Faiyum, Wikipedia infobox coordinate (29°18'30"N 30°50'39"E) -- the historic city center, used as the nearest named anchor for the gazetted endpoint 'adjacent to the Fayoum Gas Company's reduction station' at the city's ring road (a few km from the exact station site, which is not independently geocodable).

sheet_conflicts: Sheet has StartLocation='Old Fayoum' and EndLocation='Old Fayoum' (identical placeholder implying an internal loop). This is substantively wrong, not a spelling issue: Ministry of Petroleum Decree 1884/2025 (same decree as P6686/P8011, line 2 -- 'Fayoum expansion-support line,' 16in, ~12km) describes a route that starts at blow-off room 2 on the *Beni Suef/New Fayoum* 24in line (near Demu village, in desert land ~9km from Fayoum city, i.e. NOT inside Old Fayoum) and runs northwest through New Demu / Kafr El-Nil villages before ending at blow-off room 4 next to the Fayoum Gas Company's pressure-reduction station by the Fayoum Ring Road (i.e. the edge of Old Fayoum). So only the END is really 'Old Fayoum' territory; the START is a tie-in point ~9km away, outside Old Fayoum proper.
notes: Same three-source corroboration as P6686/P8011 (elwatannews full decree text; vetogate independent reproduction; almasdar decree summary) since all three lines were approved in one decree. Sheet length 12.0km matches the gazetted ~12km exactly. Demu's coordinate is OSM-sourced (a real, named locality 7km east of Fayoum city per Egyptian press profiles of the village) rather than Wikipedia/GeoNames, since Demu has no English Wikipedia page; flagged as slightly lower-tier basis than the other Fayoum endpoints.

start.name: New Fayoum City (tie-in on the Beni Suef/New Fayoum 24in line, blow-off room 3, edge of New Fayoum City)
start.coord_basis: New Faiyum, Wikipedia infobox coordinate (29°13'26"N 30°53'48"E) -- same anchor as P6686's end point, since this line's start is explicitly the same blow-off room (room 3) where the Beni Suef/New Fayoum line terminates.

end.name: Itsa (Etsa) town center, Faiyum Governorate
end.coord_basis: Itsa, Wikipedia infobox coordinate (29°14'15"N 30°47'22"E) -- a real town/markaz south of Fayoum city.

spelling_fixes.EndLocation: Itsa (Etsa) -- Arabic إطسا; sheet spelling 'Atsa' is a transliteration variant that should be normalized to Itsa/Etsa, the standard English form.

sheet_conflicts: Sheet has StartLocation='Atsa' and EndLocation='Atsa' (same place twice). Decree 1884/2025 (line 3, 'Itsa supply line,' 16in, ~9.5km) actually starts at blow-off room 3 -- the shared tie-in with the end of the Beni Suef/New Fayoum line (P6686), i.e. at/near New Fayoum City, in desert land -- and runs west through agricultural land to end at blow-off room 5 near Itsa town center. So the START should be New Fayoum City, not Itsa; only the END is Itsa/Etsa.
notes: Same three-source corroboration (elwatannews full decree text; vetogate; almasdar summary). Sheet length 9.5km matches the gazetted figure exactly ('Itsa supply line 16in, ~9.5km'), which combined with the sheet's own spelling ('Atsa'~'Itsa') strongly confirms this row is that decree line despite the wrong start-location value. Hint confirmed: Atsa = Itsa إطسا.

Searched English and Arabic (خط غاز الفيوم الجيزة, GASCO/EGAS project pages, Egyptian press, official-gazette search) with no hit on a discrete decree, GASCO project page, or news item describing a 27km Fayoum-to-Giza gas line. gem.wiki has no page yet for this pipeline (blank), so no internal lead there either. Speculative/unsourced corridor guess only: given the naming convention (GASCO/Ministry lines are routinely named '<place A>-<place B>'), this is plausibly a link between the Fayoum distribution network (e.g. the Fayoum-Giza desert road corridor near Demu/New Fayoum City, see P8012's start) and a point in rural Giza Governorate's Nile-valley markaz (Atfih/Badrashin/El-Saff), which would roughly fit a 27km span -- but this is not sourced and should not be treated as more than a hypothesis for a follow-up search (e.g. querying the Egyptian Official Gazette portal directly, or GASCO/EGAS annual reports, for a 'Fayoum-Giza' or similarly named decree).

start.name: Hadaeq El-Solaimaneyah (حدائق السليمانية), Giza Governorate
start.coord_basis: OSM/Nominatim-geocoded village/district named 'Hadaeq El-Solaimaneyah' (postal code 12588), Giza Governorate -- the only place bearing the pipeline's own name ('Solaimaneyah') found in Giza Governorate via public gazetteer search. end.name: North Giza Power Station area (El Qata, Munshaat al-Qanater, Giza Governorate)
end.coord_basis: Wikidata Q56359846 (North Giza Power Station), a sourced coordinate for the power plant that anchors the 'North Giza' end of the corridor; the agrinewz article independently places the pipeline's path near Munshaat al-Qanater in the same area.

sheet_conflicts: IMPORTANT: the prior facility_anchor supplied for this row's 'end' (GEM entity 'Giza Gas Field (Egypt)', lon 29.846/lat 31.703, marked non-citable) is a NAME-COLLISION MISMATCH and should not be used. That GEM entity is the offshore 'Giza' gas field, part of BP's West Nile Delta project ~65-85km off the Alexandria coast (per BP and offshore-technology.com reporting) -- it has nothing to do with 'North Giza' in this pipeline's name, which the sourced decree/press instead ties to an onshore corridor through Giza and Monufia Governorates near Munshaat al-Qanater (consistent with the North Giza power station's location). Sheet's plain 'Giza' as EndLocation is directionally fine but under-specific -- the official name is specifically 'North Giza' (شمال الجيزة), a defined area, not central Giza city.
notes: Two levels of corroboration: (1) the pipeline's existence, name, 42in diameter and 20km length are confirmed by Ministry of Petroleum Decree 1883/2025 (gazetted 16 Dec 2025) via Giza Governorate's follow-on land-expropriation Decree 297/2026 (independently reported by dostor.org and vetogate.com, both quoting the same governorate decree text); (2) the corridor and purpose (expanding the national gas grid to underserved areas / boosting network pressure, built by Petrojet under GASCO, running through Giza and Monufia Governorates alongside the Regional Ring Road near Munshaat al-Qanater) are described in a third, independent article (agrinewz, reporting on a Giza Agriculture Directorate meeting about the project's land impact). Endpoint-precision caveat: the 'Solaimaneyah' start is the weaker of the two coordinates -- OSM has only one place of that name in Giza Governorate ('Hadaeq El-Solaimaneyah'), which is plausible but the great-circle distance to North Giza (~25.5km) runs longer than the pipeline's own stated 20km length, meaning this is very likely in the right area but not an exact tie-in point. A human GIS pass against the Regional Ring Road corridor would tighten this.
